algorithm: SAM3D (Yang et al.) ViT-H pinhole lift
measurement_scope: foundation zero-shot / promptable mask → stud labels → minimal OBB; synthetic scene only; not a field accuracy

scene.name: stage0_2x4_lean0.000
scene.reference_meaning: This synthetic scene has no floor. The generator +Z axis is the angle reference. The cloud is not rotated. A SKIL or other level reading is not the reference.
scene.description: Synthetic single stud. Generator gravity is +Z.

implementation.note: 2D SAM ViT-H + z-buffer lift. pointops knn is install smoke only.

implementation_short: SAM ViT-H on scaffold pinhole, best mask lifted to points → stud labels.

detection.note: 8311 points labeled stud (class 1) of 25666. A box is fit when that count is at least 50. Counts are this synthetic scene, not a field accuracy.

geometry.note: Section and length are the minimal OBB of the stud-labeled points versus the dressed generator stud. Same box as the classical finders.

angle.band_meaning: Percent of matched studs whose |measured - synthetic truth| is within the working tolerance.
angle.note: Truth is the generator axis against +Z. This scene has no floor. Synthetic tests measure lean against the fitted floor normal when the scene has a floor or slab, and against generator +Z only when it does not. They do not use a SKIL or any other level reading.

paint.production_rule: epsilon unlocked, so every stud is yellow
paint.hypothetical_placeholder_note: 0.05 deg is a round illustration of the color rule. It is not a measured device band.
paint.note: Do not read hypothetical colors as a pass/fail call.
